steps.what: Read the organisation's current question and applicable institutional rules
Advise student officers and discuss their actual decisions and difficulties

tasks.design: Keep organisation advising human, supported by the existing current-rules view in {DOCS}. Reading the actual question and applying institutional rules remain necessary; no additional record or automated action is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value is contextual advice and support for student officers rather than repeated processing.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing native rules view already supplies the relevant documents; no additional labour-removing change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing student initiative, institutional boundaries and interpersonal disagreements.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when to guide student officers and when to leave a decision with them.
tasks.altitude: No change to advising work or authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: student organisation advising involves contextual discussion and applying institutional rules; a separate adviser record is not inherent to the task.

assumptions: Provisional shares cover an actual organisation question and advising discussion. The organisation produces its question and student officers supply current concerns; s1 counts reading these inputs.

Record, report, lookup and send boundaries were inspected before assigning zero. Rule reading is separately counted in s1. No adviser-owned minutes, student-progress record, grant application or external booking is established by this task; do not invent them.

A native current-rules view is assessed first. In this scenario the document is directly available, so full applicability reading remains and no repeat navigation baseline is invented. A question template cannot replace the actual students' concerns.
If the adviser actually writes required minutes, an approval form or an outbound recommendation, add that observed work and assess its native template before using this estimate.
No new implementation or recurring upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Whether any institution-specific adviser form or written recommendation is actually required
research_questions: Observe an advising encounter and identify any real write, lookup or send beyond the counted rules reading.

incremental.description: No new automation or recurring upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain all 10 rule-reading points and 90 discussion points. A difficult disagreement retains the same human work; no fictional adviser record or calendar preparation is used to manufacture a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Develop the actual research question, methods and funding strategy
Verify references, preliminary evidence and budget inputs
Write the funder-specific research proposal narrative

loop.purpose: Draft supported narrative from the researcher's actual proposal specification
loop.input: research specification, checked evidence and funder requirements
loop.check: Researcher checks claims, citations, methods, uncertainty, feasibility and omitted funder conditions
loop.stop: An unsupported claim or two failed drafts returns the section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native funder headings first; supported research rationale needs limited prose drafting

steps.what: Assemble specified budget calculations and required proposal tables
Check the complete narrative, budget and all proposal conditions
Review institutional commitments and authorise the final funder submission
Submit the exact authorised package to the specified funder

tasks.design: Test the funder's native template before connecting checked {ERP} cost inputs to deterministic budget tables and a source-bound narrative draft in {DOCS}. Keep research design, source verification and complete proposal checking human, then submit only the final package authorised by the existing research office.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative restatement and budget-table assembly repeat around original research design.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic funder tables plus bounded drafting from researcher-supplied evidence.
tasks.still_hard: A worthwhile research question, defensible methods and realistic institutional commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the research contribution and defend the proposed methods.
tasks.altitude: Less supported narrative and table assembly, with research ownership unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: checked cost tables and source-bound proposal drafting can assist grant authorship; research design and institutional authorisation remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares include actual grant writing through submission. Focal denominator is 90; research-office review is retained other-role labour, never claimed as saved.

s1 creates the research specification. s2 manually verifies citations, preliminary results, personnel effort, rates, currency and eligible cost categories supplied by the researcher and finance records; missing inputs require human resolution.

Native funder tables and headings are tested first. Removed drafting time is supported restatement only; no original idea, data, citation or method is invented. All final source, budget and condition checks remain.

Research-office review occurs after the complete package exists. Changed narrative, budget or destination voids approval and returns for review. Ordinary author saves remain inside retained writing/checking; submission is a distinct actual external action.
No confidential proposal peer review is automated.
unknowns: Funder template reuse and permitted drafting route
research_questions: Can the proposal budget be reproduced exactly from verified rates and effort?
How much supported narrative remains reusable after the researcher's complete check?

incremental.description: Maintain funder mappings and source-bound drafting checks

approvals.approved_version: s6 exact final narrative, budget, attachments and funder destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross (7.5 narrative plus 10 table points)/90 times 100=19.444, less 1.2 upkeep gives 18.244. A new funder format retains most prose and eligibility work, leaving only 2 narrative and 3 table points removable: 5/90 times 100 minus 1.2=4.355, conservatively 4.3.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide professional consulting to government or industry

steps.what: Agree the consulting question, scope and actual client deliverable
Collect and verify the client's facts and relevant professional evidence
Analyse alternatives and determine the professional recommendation
Write the commissioned client advice document

loop.purpose: Restate the consultant's supported findings for the agreed client audience
loop.check: Consultant checks meaning, evidence, uncertainty, limits and omitted conditions against the agreed recommendation
loop.stop: Unsupported claim or two failed drafts returns writing to the consultant
loop.why_not_simpler: Native report headings first; contextual explanations need limited prose restatement

steps.what: Check the complete final advice, attachments and client recipient
Send the exact authorised advice to the client

tasks.design: Use a native consulting template in {DOCS}, with a bounded restatement of the consultant's own checked recommendation. Keep scope, data collection, professional judgement and complete advice checking human, then retain a separate gated client send in {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing audience-appropriate explanations repeats material already settled in the analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting within an approved client-data route.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the client's actual constraints and choosing defensible recommendations.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise what the evidence permits and communicate its limits honestly.
tasks.altitude: Less explanatory restatement, with professional responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound restatement can assist commissioned advice writing while analysis and professional recommendations remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares describe a consulting engagement whose agreed deliverable is written advice, not a new internal record. Oral-only consulting must remove and reweight document/send work.

s1 establishes the actual deliverable. s2 includes obtaining and verifying client-supplied facts, source identifiers, dates and scope limitations; missing facts require manual follow-up. s3 produces the recommendation before drafting.

Test native templates first. Five removed points concern supported explanatory restatement only, not evidence collection, professional judgement or complete checking. No additional trailing administration record is invented.

s5 checks the exact final advice and destination after the document exists. Changes void approval. Same-system author saves remain within retained writing, and the actual client send stays fully retained.
unknowns: Actual consulting deliverable and confidentiality terms
research_questions: Does source-bound restatement reduce writing after the complete professional meaning check?

incremental.description: Maintain consulting template and drafting checks

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final client advice, attachments and recipient; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20 times 25%=5 restatement points less 1 upkeep gives 4. An unfamiliar government policy question needs new explanation and caveats, leaving only 1.5 points of supported factual restatement removable and 0.5 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep student-organisation advice and research or consulting judgement; reduce supported writing where an actual document is required.
role.ambitious_version: Use verified drafting savings for better research design and client explanation.
